sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ADMISSION THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM:

HON'BLE MR JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA  ORAL JUDGMENT Heard Sri.V.B.Siddaramaiah, learned counsel for the appellant, Sri.T.P.Malipatil, learned Additional Government Advocate for respondent No.1 and Sri.Bheemaiah K.S., learned counsel for respondent No.2/beneficiary.
2. Appeal Miscellaneous Second Appeal is filed by the claimant seeking for enhancement of the compensation in respect of the acquired land in C.Nandihalli Village for the purpose of Hemavathi Canal.
3. Facts which are not in dispute are that the land of the claimant in Sy.No.25/1 of C.Nandihalli Village to the extent of 03 guntas was acquired for the purpose of construction of Hemavathi Canal.

4. Determination of the compensation by the Land Acquisition Officer, reference Court and First Appellate Court NC: 2024:KHC:31694 are tabulated for the sake of ready reference and convenience as under:
 Court Total Land - 0.03 Guntas  SLAO Rs.28,546/- for 27 Arecanut & 04 Coconut  (Totally 31 trees)
 Reference Rs. 39,680/- for 27 Arecanut trees i.e.,
 Court Rs.1469.63 (Rs.1470/-) per Arecanut  Tree &
Rs.34,020/- for 04 coconut Trees i.e., Rs.8,505/- per coconut tree Appellate Appeal allowed with respect to the land and Court dismissed with respect to trees.

5. Being not satisfied with award of compensation by reference Court and First Appellate Court,
appellants are before this Court.

Sri .V.B.Siddaramaiah reiterating the grounds urged in the appeal Sri. Manjunathaiah vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58907364/
2 memorandum contended that the determination of the compensation in respect of the coconut tree and areca nut tree are on the lower side and sought for suitable enhancement.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Per contra, learned counsel for respondents supports the impugned orders, wherein determination according to them is just and proper.
7. Having heard the parties, this Court perused the material on record meticulously.

In respect of same notification and similarly placed claimants, matter attained finality before this Court in MFA.No.6195/2012 dated 19.09.2018, wherein the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court has determined the value for the trees in a sum of Rs.7,907/- per coconut tree and sum of Rs.5,000/-
per areca nut tree.

9. Since there is no appeal filed by the beneficiary or the government with regard to the four coconut trees which have been lost in the acquisition in respect of the claimant, the determination of the compensation in respect of the four coconut trees kept intact.

10. Insofar as the areca nut trees are concerned, in terms of the order of coordinate Bench of this Court in the aforesaid Miscellaneous First Appeal, claimants are entitled to sum of Rs.5,000/- per areca nut tree for the loss of entire 27 areca nut trees.

11. Hence, the following:
ORDER
The appeal is allowed in part.

The claimant/appellant is entitled to compensation at the rate of Rs.5,000/- per areca nut tree for the loss of 27 areca nut trees with all consequential reliefs, less the payment of interest for the delayed period of 1025 days in filing the appeal.
Sd/-
(V SRISHANANDA) JUDGE NR/-
